answer: For every name, 95 stamped dockets, each costing £12 to have checked leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. The horizon is that Tenterbound journeyman madder dyer vat warrant is the toll on this road, and a warrant journeyman madder dyers show after dyehouse trials is what the toll collector checks. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Every opal is counted once. One saffron, one entry.
